source_abilities.E:
Deploy a disruptive wall of energy, blocking all incoming Enemy Projectiles for 4s.
When an Enemy Hero first passes through the wall, they take 50/75/100/125/150 (+30% magical power) magical damage and are Slowed by 25/30/35/40/45% for 0.75s.
source_abilities.R: Leap into the sky, crashing down at the target location to deal 200/320/440 (+90% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies in the area, Knocking them Up and Stunning them for 1.5s.

terra.pick_when: Pick her as a practiced, matchup-specific frontline answer when her armor-scaled control fits the draft; she is not a default pick in either role.
terra.counterplay: Respect the empowered control and ultimate window, then trade afterward. Keep distance from the charged or committed sequence rather than feeding her preferred sustained melee exchange.

source_abilities.RMB:
Terra becomes Unstoppable and Channels for up to 3.5s before dashing. She deals 27/48/69/90/111 (+40% bonus physical armor) (+40% bonus magical armor) physical damage to all Enemies in her path, stopping if she collides with a Hero. Enemies hit are Knocked Back for 0.25s.
For the first 1.25s, dash range and damage increases, dealing up to 81/144/207/270/333 (+120% bonus physical armor) (+120% bonus magical armor) physical damage. 
Empowered: On Enemy hit, gain a 5/65/125/185/245 (+10/12/14/16/18% health) shield for 3.5s.
source_abilities.Q:
Terra spins her axe, striking all Enemies around her before slashing forward a second time. Each strike deals 50/80/110/140/170 (+35% physical armor)(+35% magical armor) physical damage.
Enemy Hero hits refund 10% of the cooldown per strike.
Empowered: Terra strikes three times, with the third strike dealing an additional (+5/6.25/7.5/8.75/10 Target's Max Health)% damage to all Enemies in front of her.
source_abilities.E:
Throw a spectral axe, dealing 80/120/160/200/240 (+30% physical armor)(+30% magical armor) physical damage to all Enemies in its path.
Enemies hit by Highland Hurl are Slowed by 40% for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s. and have their Physical Armor reduced by 20% for 4.5s.
Empowered: Roots Enemies instead for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s.
source_abilities.R:
Terra’s helmet slams down, Cleansing all debuffs and disabling Enemy Towers within 1650u for 4/4.5/5s. When this occurs, she instantly gains maximum Hersir stacks and Slows all nearby Enemy Units by 60%, decaying over 2s.
For the next 8/9/10s, Terra gains 16/30/44 Physical Armor, 16/30/44 Magical Armor and 50/100/150 Tenacity.
Passive: Gain 6/9/12 Physical Armor and 6/9/12 Magical Armor.

the-fey.pick_when: Pick prepared catch into magical area damage with a durable ally establishing the space.
the-fey.counterplay: Keep movement for Fly Trap's delay, spread before the pull and avoid donating repeated Nettles hits. Approach from a second angle instead of stacking inside the prepared damage area.

source_abilities.Q:
Summon a patch of thorny brambles, dealing 90/130/170/210/250 (+70% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies that touch them and Slowing them by 35% for 0.5s. Allies within the brambles gain 15% movement speed for 0.5s.
Bramble Patch persists for 5s before wilting.
source_abilities.E:
Throw an orb of energy, dealing 80/120/160/200/240 (+55% magical power) magical damage. Hitting the same Target within 8s deals 20% increased damage, stacking up to 4 times.
Harvest Nettles refunds 75% of its mana cost upon hitting an Enemy Hero or Killing a Unit.
source_abilities.R:
Plant a magical seedling, awakening a giant fly trap that attaches itself to all nearby Enemy Heroes. 
After a brief delay, it Pulls its victims inward, dealing 250/375/500 (+100% magical power) magical damage and Stunning them for 1s.

twinblast.pick_when: Pick ability-attack weaving and self-repositioning for a practiced carry.
twinblast.counterplay: Force Rocket Dash, then send the second threat. Keep moving through Ventilate's aim and avoid giving repeated free attack-spell exchanges while your escape is unavailable.

source_abilities.Q: TwinBlast charges and fires two superheated piercing projectiles in the target direction, dealing a total of 100/140/180/220/260 (+90% physical power)(+120% magical power) physical damage and applying on-hit effects to all Enemy Units hit at 170% effectiveness.
source_abilities.E:
Passive: When TwinBlast deals damage to an Enemy Hero with a Basic Attack or Ability, Rocket Dash's cooldown is decreased by 8/9/10/11/12%. Reduced to 3.2/3.6/4/4.4/4.8% when damaging Non-Heroes.
Active: TwinBlast dashes in his current movement direction.
source_abilities.R:
Transform your guns into fully automatic machine guns, unleashing a barrage of 30 (+10% Total Attack Speed) bullets over 3s dealing 15/20/25 (+9% physical power)(+9% magical power) physical damage per bullet. 
Can Critically Strike at 75% effectiveness.
source_abilities.Passive: Casting an ability grants TwinBlast 20% increased Total Attack Speed and will cause his next basic attack within 4s to fire three times for a total of 142.5% damage, with each shot applying on-hit effects at 60% effectiveness.

wraith.pick_when: Pick a practiced skill-shot carry with a clear damage-conversion plan and catch assistance.
wraith.counterplay: Use cover against the shot line and track the reveal and rewind setup. Check the augment before choosing armor: Mystic Marksman makes Knock, Knock! magical, while the midlane Sniper's Bounty build keeps it physical.

source_abilities.RMB:
Fire a long-range sniper shot that deals 20/35/50/65/80 (+110% physical power)(+70% magical power) physical damage to the first Enemy Unit hit. Damage is increased by 100% against Enemy Minions. Knock, Knock! benefits from lifesteal.
If Knock, Knock! Kills, or Damages a marked Unit, 35% of the Mana Cost is refunded and its Cooldown is decreased by 75%.
source_abilities.Q:
Launch a piercing Nanite Grenade that deals 40/60/80/100/120 (+60% physical power)(+50% magical power) physical damage to all Units hit, Slowing them by 35% for 1.25s. Units hit are also Marked for 3.5s, Revealing them.
Knock, Knock! is enhanced against Marked Units, dealing an extra 5.5/6/6.5/7/7.5% (+1.5% magical power per 100 Magical Power) of their maximum health as bonus magical damage.
source_abilities.R: Wraith can choose an Enemy Hero he can see up to 1550/1650/1750 units, marking their location from 2s prior. After a 1.5s delay they will enter Limbo and Teleport back to this location.

wukong.pick_when: Pick mobile pressure and repeated access while another hero supplies the dependable frontline.
wukong.counterplay: Keep the escape route covered and identify the real hero before committing scarce control. Do not infer clone on-hit behavior or spend all peel chasing an expendable copy.

source_abilities.Q:
Spirit:
Wukong gains 6/7/8/9/10/11% movement speed and creates a trail of cloud, walkable by allies for 4s.
Body:
Wukong leaps in the current movement direction gaining 20/24/28/32/36/40% (+60% physical penetration) Attack Speed for 4s.
source_abilities.E:
Spirit:
Wukong spins his staff around himself gaining 25% (+50% physical penetration) Damage Reduction for the duration. Afterwards he throws the staff forward dealing 60/80/100/120/140/160 (+70% physical power) damage and Stunning for 0.8s.
Body:
Wukong enlarges his staff and slams down to the ground dealing 60/100/140/180/220/260 (+135% physical power) damage and slowing by 40% for 0.75. This damage is increased by drop distance up to 1500 units. Minions receive 70% less damage.
source_abilities.R:
Switch between Body and Spirit Stances
Upon damaging Enemies 5 times, a hair leaps from Wukong and lands, spawning a Clone. Clones deal (+12% physical power) physical damage per hit and have 16%( health) Health. Wukong may have up to 2/3/4/5 clones at one time.
Leaving combat will reset the counter.
source_abilities.Passive: Double Jump to leap into the air.

yin.pick_when: Pick a confident projectile-timing player into attacks her defensive tools can actually answer.
yin.counterplay: Bait Backlash or wait out the projectile-control window, then commit from another angle. Do not assume a projectile answer stops ground areas or non-projectile control; a Ground effect now interrupts Lash Kick.

source_abilities.RMB:
Yin cracks her whip, Pushing away nearby Enemies. Deals 20/40/60/80/100 (+100% physical power)(+60% magical power) physical damage and creates a sphere of pressure around her for 0.8s.
If Enemy projectiles hit the sphere, they are reflected toward the target location.
source_abilities.E:
Passive: Every third successful consecutive basic attack will deal 2/2.5/3/3.5/4% of the target’s maximum health as bonus physical damage and heals Yin for +(10/12/14/16/18% physical power) Health.
Active: Yin extends her whip, increasing the range of her basic attack to 1100 units 
and gaining 30/40/50/60/70% cleave for 6s.
source_abilities.R:
Yin surrounds herself in gale winds.
For 5s, the winds will apply a 10% Slow to Enemies within and grants Yin 10% movement speed. 
Enemy projectiles that travel through it are halted.

yurei.pick_when: Pick marked-target mobility and attack weaving after an ally creates the opening.
yurei.counterplay: Avoid leaving a chain of marked reachable targets. Punish Severance without its reset condition, and hold control, including a Ground effect, for the 1.5s Soulstorm channel rather than following her through every reset.

source_abilities.RMB: Launch three projectiles that explode, each dealing 30/40/50/60/70 (+35% physical power) damage to targets hit and apply Soul Rip to them for 4s.
source_abilities.Q:
Perform a spinning kick that deals 70/90/110/130/150 (+70% physical power) physical damage to nearby enemies and apply Soul Rip to them for 4s.
If cast in-air, you will additionaly leap upwards in your current movement direction.
Heal 20/35/50/65/80 (+75% physical power) health, increased by 0-50% based on missing health if an Enemy Hero or Monster is hit.
source_abilities.E:
Rush forwards, dealing 55/75/95/115/135 (+115% physical power) physical damage to targets hit.
Colliding with a target affected by Soul Rip consumes it to reset the cooldown of Severance and tear their Soul from the target for 4s. Souls linger around their hosts with 8% of their maximum health and share any damage dealt to them with their host.
Consuming Soul Rip with a Soul still active will refresh its health.
source_abilities.R:
Channel for 1.5s, dealing 75/125/175 (+50% physical power) physical damage to nearby enemies and applying Soul Rip to them.
At the end of the duration, pull all targets towards you, tear their spirits and strike downwards, dealing 130/215/300 (+80% physical power) physical damage and reset the cooldown of Severence.

zarus.pick_when: Pick jungle containment with mid/support conversion and a disciplined exit plan.
zarus.counterplay: Do not spend burst into Barricade's damage reduction; step away from its stunning swing. Keep an escape or peel response for Coliseum and attack the unsupported entry. The arena limits movement but does not silence or stun everyone inside; continue using valid defensive tools.

source_abilities.Q:
Unfold a shield for 1.5s, reducing incoming damage by 75%.
Upon recasting or after the duration, swing the shield dealing 54/70/86/102/118 (+90% physical power) physical damage increased up to 135/175/215/255/295 (+225% physical power) and Stunning targets hit for 0.75s.
source_abilities.E:
Dash in your current movement direction, gaining 20% movement speed for 1s and 12/16/20/24/28% (+20% magical power) Attack Speed for 3.5s.
If cast in-air, you will additionally dash slightly upwards in your current movement direction.
source_abilities.R:
Leap at an Enemy Hero, dealing 200/325/450 (+100% physical power) physical damage. A Coliseum is then summoned for 4s, Zarus gains maximum stacks of Gladiator and its bonus is doubled. 
If the target is killed within the duration, you will permanently gain 5/8/11 Physical Power.

zinx.pick_when: In support, choose protection for a planned committed fight with another slot initiating; in offlane, choose her ranged attack-and-spell pressure beside another frontline.
zinx.counterplay: Bait Neural Regenesis before the decisive focus, or change targets during protection; its cooldown is shorter at lower ranks on 1.17. Spread from the bouncing control and track the actual Infuse recipient instead of assuming every build heals allies equally.

source_abilities.LMB:
Ranged basic attack dealing 46/48.38/50.89/53.52/56.29/59.18/62.19/65.34/68.61/72.01/75.54/79.19/82.98/86.89/90.92/95.09/99.38/103.8 (+55% physical power) physical damage.
Enemies hit are afflicted with a stacking DoT that deals 12/13.8/15.6/17.4/19.2/21/22.8/24.6/26.4/28.2/30/31.8/33.6/35.4/37.2/39/40.8/42.6 (+12% magical power) (+0.6 per Level) magical damage on-hit over 3s.
source_abilities.RMB: Fire a healing bolt at an Ally that restores 60/95/130/165/200 (+50% magical power) Health, increasing by up to 50% based on their missing health.
source_abilities.Q:
Throw an electromagnetic disk dealing 65/90/115/140/165 (+40% magical power) magical damage and Stunning for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s.
The disk can ricochet up to 5 times, dealing its damage again and Stunning each target for 50% of the original duration. 
Will not ricochet to previously hit targets.
source_abilities.E:
Shoot the ground to form a pool of radiation that deals 45/65/85/105/125 (+40% magical power) magical damage and Slows by 35% for 0.75s.
After 0.75s, the radiation erupts dealing 55/85/115/145/175 (+45% magical power) magical damage and Slowing Enemies hit by 35% for 0.75s.
source_abilities.R:
Apply cellular restructuring to Yourself or an Ally Hero, granting 45% decaying Movement Speed and Revival for 4s.
If the Target takes lethal damage within this time, they Resurrect with 500/900/1300 (+235% magical power) Health and 250/400/550 (+110% magical power) Mana after 2.5s.

counter_picks.reason: Hold Shield Bash or Shield Slam for the reappearance/landing rather than spending both on the first tank.
counter_picks.limit: The selected Crushing Descent adds a brief interrupt; do not assume she cannot interrupt your response.

steel.RMB:
Swipe forward with Steel's shield, dealing 35/65/95/125/155 (+50% magical power) (+5/5.75/6.5/7.25/8% of the Target's maximum health) magical damage to all Enemies in front of him and Stunning them for 0.5s.
Deals 50/55/60/65/70 additional damage to Monsters.
steel.R: Leap into the sky, crashing down at the target location to deal 200/320/440 (+90% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies in the area, Knocking them Up and Stunning them for 1.5s.

serath.Q:
Serath marks a Target and vanishes, striking Enemies at their location 5 times. Each strike deals 40/60/80/100/120 (+20% physical power) physical damage and applies on-hit effects at 35% effectiveness. Additional strikes against the same Target deal 30% damage. Deals 40/50/60/70/80 bonus damage to Monsters.
On her final strike, Serath will teleport to the marked Target's location based on her current position.
If the marked Target dies, Serath teleports immediately.
serath.E:
Serath rises up into the air and hovers for up to 1.8s. During this time, she can target an area up to 1350 units away. Upon confirmation, she dives down and deals 80/100/120/140/160 (+80% physical power)(+50% magical power) physical damage.
Serath automatically dives to the ground after 1.8s

counter_picks.reason: Use Gag Grenade to deny a response after she becomes targetable, then preserve the airborne blast to separate.
counter_picks.limit: Silence is short and the timing must follow the disappearance; damage still needs a safe firing line.

drongo.Q: Toss a tear gas grenade that explodes dealing 45/65/85/105/125 (+80% physical power)(+120% magical power) physical damage to Enemy Targets hit and silencing them for 0.8/0.9/1/1.1/1.2s. The gas lasts for 3s, applying Wastelander every 0.3s.
drongo.R:
Unleash a bazooka blast, dealing 170/280/390 (+115% physical power) physical damage to all Enemies hit and Shredding their Physical Armor by 30% for 4s. 
When used In-Air, the blast launches Drongo in the opposite direction, becoming briefly CC Immune and Pushing Back any Enemies in front of him.

serath.Q:
Serath marks a Target and vanishes, striking Enemies at their location 5 times. Each strike deals 40/60/80/100/120 (+20% physical power) physical damage and applies on-hit effects at 35% effectiveness. Additional strikes against the same Target deal 30% damage. Deals 40/50/60/70/80 bonus damage to Monsters.
On her final strike, Serath will teleport to the marked Target's location based on her current position.
If the marked Target dies, Serath teleports immediately.
serath.E:
Serath rises up into the air and hovers for up to 1.8s. During this time, she can target an area up to 1350 units away. Upon confirmation, she dives down and deals 80/100/120/140/160 (+80% physical power)(+50% magical power) physical damage.
Serath automatically dives to the ground after 1.8s

counter_picks.reason: Keep a hook or silence response for the channel rather than opening with every control tool. In melee range, Shock Therapy destroys shields before its damage and silence; time it before the 2.75-second transition.
counter_picks.limit: A live Truesilver shield prevents control; break or wait out that protection before relying on the interrupt. Black Hole becomes non-cancellable after 2.75s of channeling, when Gideon may act. Protect or interrupt the early phase; after that point, prioritize positioning and leaving the zone.

riktor.RMB: Launch Riktor's chain forward, attaching to the first Enemy hit, dealing 10/50/90/130/170 (+100% magical power) (+10% of the Target's Max Health) magical damage and Pulling them towards him.
riktor.Q: Swing an electrified whip that destroys enemy shields before dealing 80/115/150/185/220 (+70% physical power)(+60% magical power) magical damage and Silencing them for 0.8s.

gideon.R:
Unleash a black hole beneath Gideon for 3.5s that slowly drags nearby Enemies towards its center, dealing 500/760/1020 (+250% magical power) magical damage. After channelling for 2.75s, Gideon may act and the Black Hole cannot be cancelled.
For each Enemy Hero hit by Black Hole, Gideon gains (+2% mana) increased Maximum Mana for 8s.

counter_picks.reason: Reserve a reachable stun for Black Hole and avoid arriving alongside every allied damage hero.
counter_picks.limit: Range and a shield that grants control immunity can prevent the intended interrupt. Black Hole becomes non-cancellable after 2.75s of channeling, when Gideon may act. Protect or interrupt the early phase; after that point, prioritize positioning and leaving the zone. A control hit does not bypass a still-active Truesilver shield.

steel.RMB:
Swipe forward with Steel's shield, dealing 35/65/95/125/155 (+50% magical power) (+5/5.75/6.5/7.25/8% of the Target's maximum health) magical damage to all Enemies in front of him and Stunning them for 0.5s.
Deals 50/55/60/65/70 additional damage to Monsters.
steel.R: Leap into the sky, crashing down at the target location to deal 200/320/440 (+90% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies in the area, Knocking them Up and Stunning them for 1.5s.

gideon.R:
Unleash a black hole beneath Gideon for 3.5s that slowly drags nearby Enemies towards its center, dealing 500/760/1020 (+250% magical power) magical damage. After channelling for 2.75s, Gideon may act and the Black Hole cannot be cancelled.
For each Enemy Hero hit by Black Hole, Gideon gains (+2% mana) increased Maximum Mana for 8s.

counter_picks.reason: Use an alternate angle to force Sparrow away from her protected firing line before she spends the full barrage.
counter_picks.limit: Her support may stop the entry; preserve an exit and do not count delayed Cryoseism as an immediate stun.

aurora.Q:
Aurora dashes forward, leaving behind a wall of ice that other Heroes can walk on for the next 5s. Reactivating the ability will destroy the wall early.
Aurora can stop her movement mid-way by using Hoarfrost or Cryoseism, or by Jumping. 
Additionally, Aurora and her Allies gain 25/30/35/40/45% Movement Speed while walking on the ice.
aurora.E:
Aurora creates a ring of frost on the ground around her. Enemies that touch the ring take 70/110/150/190/230 (+50% magical power) magical damage and are Rooted for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s.
The ring remains in the world for 2.5s.
aurora.R:
Aurora freezes an area, applying a 50% Slow to all Enemies for 1.5s. After 1.5s, the ice freezes, Stunning the target for 1s. After the Stun, the Target explodes dealing 200/300/400 (+70% magical power) magical damage to them and nearby Enemies.
Enemies damaged by Cryoseism will be Slowed by 50% for 0.5s before exploding, dealing 60/90/120 (+20% magical power) magical damage to them and nearby Enemies. Targets can only be slowed this way once per Cryoseism.

sparrow.E:
Sparrow vanishes from the battlefield, entering Stealth and gaining 30 (+15% magical power) Movement Speed for 1.5s. Upon, reappearing, she gains 25/30/35/40/45% Attack Speed for 6s.
Every second subsequent basics attack against the same target while Heightened Senses is active deals (+15% physical power) bonus physical damage and applies an additional stack of Relentless.
sparrow.R:
Unleash a barrage of fanned arrows, firing 12/14/16 volleys over 3.5s. 
The center arrow deals (+75% physical power)(+40% magical power) physical damage. Side arrows deal (+58% physical power)(+30% magical power) damage instead.
Inner Fire's arrows pierce Enemy Units, can Critically Strike and apply On-Hit effects at 30% effectiveness.

counter_picks.reason: Threaten the rock from an unseen angle and commit the leap only when allies can convert.
counter_picks.limit: A missed boulder or protected carry turns the tank into free attack uptime.

rampage.Q:
Rip a boulder from the earth and carry it for up to 5s. Rampage can throw the boulder, dealing 100/135/170/205/240 (+60% physical power)(+80% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies in its path, Stunning them for 1.2/1.25/1.3/1.35/1.4s. Shatters on contact with Enemy Heroes.
Behemoth: Throw the boulder instantly.
rampage.RMB:
Leap forward before slamming down to the ground, dealing 80/110/140/170/200 (+5% health) physical damage to nearby Enemies and launching damaged Heroes backwards. The leap can be cancelled early by basic attacking.
Using Pounce while Boulder Throw is active causes it to shatter upon landing, dealing its effects in the area.
Behemoth: Range increases by 65%.

sparrow.E:
Sparrow vanishes from the battlefield, entering Stealth and gaining 30 (+15% magical power) Movement Speed for 1.5s. Upon, reappearing, she gains 25/30/35/40/45% Attack Speed for 6s.
Every second subsequent basics attack against the same target while Heightened Senses is active deals (+15% physical power) bonus physical damage and applies an additional stack of Relentless.
sparrow.R:
Unleash a barrage of fanned arrows, firing 12/14/16 volleys over 3.5s. 
The center arrow deals (+75% physical power)(+40% magical power) physical damage. Side arrows deal (+58% physical power)(+30% magical power) damage instead.
Inner Fire's arrows pierce Enemy Units, can Critically Strike and apply On-Hit effects at 30% effectiveness.

counter_picks.reason: Threaten the exposed enchanter with a confirmed hook so she must spend protection defensively.
counter_picks.limit: A missed hook is not pressure; allies must reach the catch before she or the carry can reverse it.

riktor.RMB: Launch Riktor's chain forward, attaching to the first Enemy hit, dealing 10/50/90/130/170 (+100% magical power) (+10% of the Target's Max Health) magical damage and Pulling them towards him.
riktor.Q: Swing an electrified whip that destroys enemy shields before dealing 80/115/150/185/220 (+70% physical power)(+60% magical power) magical damage and Silencing them for 0.8s.

muriel.E:
Throw an orb that applies a 80/120/160/200/240 (+50% magical power) shield to the first Allied Hero it touches, granting them 15/17.5/20/22.5/25% Decaying Movement Speed for 4s.
Remains in the world for 8s if untouched.
muriel.R:
Prepare for flight, allowing Muriel to target an Allied Hero anywhere in the world, granting them 30% Damage Reduction and a 280/480/680 (+100% magical power) Shield for 2.5s as you soar to their location.
On arrival, nearby Enemies take 100/160/220 (+40% magical power) magical damage and are Knocked Up for 0.5s.

counter_picks.reason: Keep Gag Grenade to silence Narbash before he can start Crash Bang Boom!, and use a compatible anti-heal purchase if grouped restoration is the problem. [2.34 consistency pass: aligned with the other role reviews and the 1.17 ability text.]
counter_picks.limit: Silence alone is not sustained anti-heal, and the support can continue protecting after it ends. Whether silence ends a drum solo already in progress is not verified.

drongo.Q: Toss a tear gas grenade that explodes dealing 45/65/85/105/125 (+80% physical power)(+120% magical power) physical damage to Enemy Targets hit and silencing them for 0.8/0.9/1/1.1/1.2s. The gas lasts for 3s, applying Wastelander every 0.3s.

narbash.Q:
Bellow out a rallying war cry, granting Narbash and empowered version of Song of My People for himself and his nearby Allies for 3/3.25/3.5/3.75/4s.
Speed: Gain 15/17.5/20/22.5/25% (+4.5% magical power) Movement Speed.
Healing: Gain 15/20/25/30/35 (+20% magical power) Health Regeneration.
narbash.E:
Toggle: Play a soothing beat, granting Narbash and his Allies additional Speed or Healing.
Healing Aura: Grants 1.5/2.5/3.5/4.5/5.5 (+2% magical power) Health Regeneration.
Speed Aura: Grants 4.5/5.5/6.5/7.5/8.5% (+3% [HasteIconWhite]) Movement Speed.
narbash.R:
Narbash Slows himself by 30% and Channels a drum solo for 3s. Nearby Enemies receive 5/7.5/10 (+3% magical power)(+5% physical power) magical damage per hit and are Slowed by 5%, stacking up to 5 times. 
Enemies afflicted with maximum Slow stacks become Mesmerized instead.
The final hit deals 80/150/220 (+80% magical power)(+120% physical power) magical damage, Knocking Up all Enemies and Stunning them for 0.5s.

counter_picks.reason: Use the stun and fence to break access after Ambush rather than fight his full sustained-contact window.
counter_picks.limit: Invigorate cleanses the stun, and Ambush or allied follow-up can still reconnect; draw out the cleanse and watch the actual route.

dekker.RMB:
Launch a bouncing bomb, dealing 70/95/120/145/170 (+45% magical power) magical damage and Stunning Enemies hit in a small area for 0.9s. 
Stun duration increases up to 1.6s based on distance (3500 units max).
dekker.E: Deploy a circular energy fence for 2.6/2.75/2.9/3.05/3.2s, preventing Enemy Heroes from passing through.

khaimera.RMB:
Leap to an Enemy Hero or Monster, dealing 75/105/135/165/195 (+70% physical power) physical damage and Slowing them by 25/30/35/40/45% for 1.35s. Deals up to 2x damage based on the Target's missing health. 
Grants 15 Rage on hit.
khaimera.E:
Khaimera instantly Cleanses all Debuffs and Heals himself for 5/7/9/11/13% of his maximum health (+4x current health regeneration).
Cleansing grants Crowd Control Immunity for 0.25s.

counter_picks.reason: Hold Seismic Assault for the committed Feast or pressure the marked return point with allies.
counter_picks.limit: A protection effect or missed line can deny the response, and 1.17's Feast damage fix makes a missed answer costlier; this is not proof of a winning lane matchup.

lt-belica.Q:
Slam the ground, sending forth a seismic wave that erupts after 0.5s, dealing 100/145/190/235/280 (+60% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies in its path, Knocking Up and Stunning them for 1s. 
Innovation: Stun duration increases to 1.4s.
The hitbox width is 270u. This ability can be Blink-proxied during the cast.

countess.Q:
Rapidly dash to a location in a cloud of blood, dealing 40/60/80/100/120 (+35% magical power) magical damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 25% for 1.25s.
A Shadow is left in your original position. Re-triggering the ability within 3.5s will swap places with the Shadow.
countess.R:
Leap to an Enemy Hero, forcing them to face Countess and Suppress them for 0.75s.
After the duration, Countess deals 135/200/265 (+5% (+2.5% magical power) of the target's maximum health) magical damage and applying Haemorrhage.
Targets already affected by Haemorrhage take 50% bonus damage and Countess restores health equal to 100% of the damage dealt.

counter_picks.reason: Attack the reachable frontline from protected range while Relentless stacks add max-health damage, and switch targets while Stone Forged Soul restores him.
counter_picks.limit: Without peel, the ranged advantage disappears; Stoicism periodically deflects a basic attack, and a barrage spent into his Stasis heal is partly undone.

sparrow.R:
Unleash a barrage of fanned arrows, firing 12/14/16 volleys over 3.5s. 
The center arrow deals (+75% physical power)(+40% magical power) physical damage. Side arrows deal (+58% physical power)(+30% magical power) damage instead.
Inner Fire's arrows pierce Enemy Units, can Critically Strike and apply On-Hit effects at 30% effectiveness.
sparrow.Passive:
Sparrow's Basic Attacks and Abilities apply stacks of Relentless to Enemy Units. 
Her Basic Attacks against Targets afflicted by Relentless deal an additional 0.25% of their maximum health as bonus physical damage On-Hit, per stack.
Relentless stacks last for 3s, stacking up to 8 times.

greystone.R:
Greystone enters Stasis for 2.5s, restoring 14/16/18% (+2.5% magical power) of his maximum health (increased by up to 2.5x based on missing health) and Slowing nearby Enemies by up to 70%, based on proximity.
After 2.5s, crash down, dealing 250/400/550 (+180% physical power)(+100% magical power) physical damage to all Enemies in the area.
greystone.Passive:
Deflect the next incoming basic attack every 15/14.4/13.8/13.2/12.6/12/11.4/10.8/10.2/9.6/9/8.4/7.8/7.2/6.6/6/5.4/4.8s.
Additionally, Greystone regenerates (+0.1% health) health per second and gains 4 (+0.5 per level) Physical Armor. 
These values are increased by 1% per 1% missing health, and the regeneration is doubled while below 50% max health.

counter_picks.reason: Force the linked pair to split their attention with a catch angle and vision denial.
counter_picks.limit: A saved pull can undo an unsupported catch; wait for the second opening rather than chasing both targets.

mourn.RMB:
Channel for up to 3s, Slowing yourself by 25% and wind up your vines, increasing their range over 1s. After 3s the ability will be cancelled and go on a 50% cooldown.
Confirm to unleash the vines that will collide with the first enemy target hit dealing 80/125/170/215/260 (+85% magical power) magical damage, Pulling them towards Mourn and Slowing them by 90% for 0.75s.
mourn.R:
Mourn channels to absorb all light from the map for 4s, causing all Enemy Heroes to have massively reduced vision.
Additionally, Mourn applies Contagion to all Heroes in the world and gains 40/60/80% Movement Speed for the duration.

phase.RMB:
Create a Link between yourself and an Ally, granting both Heroes 3/4/5/6/7% increased Physical Power and Magical Power. If reactivated, Phase will Pull the Linked Ally towards her.
The Link will turn Pink if any Ally wanders too far out of range and will break if they do not return within 1s.
Allies that are Immobilized cannot be Pulled.
Maximum link radius is 1700u. If the linked ally is 2100u away, the link breaks immediately, regardless of the one-second grace window.

counter_picks.reason: Keep control beside the threatened carry and deny the exposed finishing route after Kallari reveals.
counter_picks.limit: Force Shield is a projectile answer, not a universal defense against melee attacks.

steel.RMB:
Swipe forward with Steel's shield, dealing 35/65/95/125/155 (+50% magical power) (+5/5.75/6.5/7.25/8% of the Target's maximum health) magical damage to all Enemies in front of him and Stunning them for 0.5s.
Deals 50/55/60/65/70 additional damage to Monsters.
steel.E:
Deploy a disruptive wall of energy, blocking all incoming Enemy Projectiles for 4s.
When an Enemy Hero first passes through the wall, they take 50/75/100/125/150 (+30% magical power) magical damage and are Slowed by 25/30/35/40/45% for 0.75s.
steel.R: Leap into the sky, crashing down at the target location to deal 200/320/440 (+90% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies in the area, Knocking them Up and Stunning them for 1.5s.

kallari.Q:
After 1.5s, enter Camouflage, gaining 40% decaying movement speed for 6s. While in this state, nearby Enemy Heroes and Wards reveal Kallari.
Attacking ends Camouflage instantly.
Passive: Gain 2 (+75% physical penetration) Health Regeneration when Out of Vision.
kallari.R:
After a brief delay Kallari dashes forward, cutting through all Enemies in her path, dealing 120/250/380 (+65/75/85% physical power) physical damage. 
Deals up to 2.5x damage based on the Target's missing health.

counter_picks.reason: Use ranged zone pressure to contest the prepared space before the team commits inside the turret nest.
counter_picks.limit: This is a composition-space answer, not a verified lane duel; Iggy & Scorch also plays midlane, and early 1.17 head-to-head games do not show Gadget winning that lane. Frontline still comes from another pick.

gadget.RMB:
Release an airborne droid that can be reactivated mid-flight to stop it in place. 
Upon stopping, the droid will follow the nearest Enemy Hero beneath it, dealing 100/160/220/280/340 (+105% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies in the area over 2.5s, and Slowing them by 20%.
gadget.Q:
Launch a sticky mine that attaches to any Enemy Hero in its path, or any nearby Unit upon landing. 
After 2.5s, the mine explodes, dealing 90/120/150/180/210 (+70% magical power) magical damage.
Landing a Basic Attack against an Enemy with an attached Sticky Mine empowers it, dealing 110/155/200/245/290 (+95% magical power) magical damage instead.
Sticky Mines that attach to yourself or Allied Units are also empowered.
gadget.R:
Unleash Gadget's Tesla Dome, dealing 480/780/1080 (+220% magical power) magical damage over 5s to all Enemies caught within. 
Each instance of damage shreds the Target's magical armor by 3.5% for 3s and briefly Slows them by 50%.
Tesla Dome grows 60% larger over its initial lifetime.

iggy-scorch.Q:
Iggy throws down a turret with 100 (+24 per Hero Level) (+10-32.5% magical power) Health that shoots homing fireballs at Enemy Targets within 1500 units. Each fireball deals 11/16/21/26/31 (+30% magical power) magical damage.
Iggy can have up to 3 turrets placed. Hitting an enemy with Spew redirects turrets to attack that target if in range. They also gain 40% Attack Speed if the Target is an Enemy Hero, or when Iggy casts Inferno.
Flame Turrets take 70% increased damage from Melee basic attacks.
iggy-scorch.E:
Scorch hurls a ball of oil that rolls in the target direction dealing 70/105/140/175/210 (+50% magical power) magical damage to enemies hit. The oil will then remain for 5s, slowing enemies by 30/35/40/45/50%.
When ignited by Iggy's fire abilities, the duration is refreshed and enemies take 10/15/20/25/30 (+12% magical power) magical damage every 0.5s.

counter_picks.reason: Threaten the short firing window with a direct catch and keep a separate response for the isolated ally's return.
counter_picks.limit: Reckoning can remove your intended focus from allied damage; coordinate which target remains reachable.

steel.RMB:
Swipe forward with Steel's shield, dealing 35/65/95/125/155 (+50% magical power) (+5/5.75/6.5/7.25/8% of the Target's maximum health) magical damage to all Enemies in front of him and Stunning them for 0.5s.
Deals 50/55/60/65/70 additional damage to Monsters.
steel.R: Leap into the sky, crashing down at the target location to deal 200/320/440 (+90% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies in the area, Knocking them Up and Stunning them for 1.5s.

revenant.LMB:
Ranged basic attack dealing 53/55.38/57.89/60.52/63.29/66.18/69.19/72.34/75.61/79.01/82.54/86.19/89.98/93.89/97.92/102.09/106.38/110.8 (+85% physical power) physical damage.
The final round will always critically strike.
After four basic attacks, Revenant will automatically reload.
revenant.R:
Revenant pulls himself and his Target into the Nether Realm for 6/7/8s and Slows them by 80% for 0.7s. During this time, he steals 8/9/10% of their Physical & Magical Power.
Killing his opponent inside the Nether Realm grants 2x the bonus gold gained from Bounty Hunter.

counter_picks.reason: Enter from another angle after defensive displacement is spent and force him to move away from his area setup.
counter_picks.limit: Do not chase through the full orbital field or assume your delayed ultimate controls him immediately.

aurora.Q:
Aurora dashes forward, leaving behind a wall of ice that other Heroes can walk on for the next 5s. Reactivating the ability will destroy the wall early.
Aurora can stop her movement mid-way by using Hoarfrost or Cryoseism, or by Jumping. 
Additionally, Aurora and her Allies gain 25/30/35/40/45% Movement Speed while walking on the ice.
aurora.E:
Aurora creates a ring of frost on the ground around her. Enemies that touch the ring take 70/110/150/190/230 (+50% magical power) magical damage and are Rooted for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s.
The ring remains in the world for 2.5s.
aurora.R:
Aurora freezes an area, applying a 50% Slow to all Enemies for 1.5s. After 1.5s, the ice freezes, Stunning the target for 1s. After the Stun, the Target explodes dealing 200/300/400 (+70% magical power) magical damage to them and nearby Enemies.
Enemies damaged by Cryoseism will be Slowed by 50% for 0.5s before exploding, dealing 60/90/120 (+20% magical power) magical damage to them and nearby Enemies. Targets can only be slowed this way once per Cryoseism.

legion.Q:
Legion fires a heavy payload that deploys 10 Cluster Mines upon hitting the world, Enemies or by reactivation. 
Each Cluster Mine deals 35/45/55/65/75 (+50% physical power) (+40% magical power) Physical Damage and Slows Enemies hit by 40% for 1s. 
Consecutive Mine hits on the same Enemy deal 25% Damage.
legion.E:
Legion calls in a standard and becomes Unstoppable for 0.5s, dealing 20/25/30/35/40 (+20% physical power) Physical Damage whilst Knocking Back nearby Enemies. 
The Standard rallies nearby Allies for 8s if they remain within 1500 units. 
Allies gain 8% Movement Speed and heal for 5/8/11/14/17 (+100% physical penetration) (+10% magical power) Health every Second.
Additionally, Enemy Wards are Revealed.
Legion gains Infinite Ammo.
legion.R:
Legion lobs a target designator that deploys upon landing. After a 0.75s delay, an Orbital Beam blasts the designated location, tracking Enemy Targets, prioritising Heroes.
Enemy Targets within the blast take 30/50/70 (+26% physical power) (+10% magical power) Physical Damage every 0.25s. The Orbital Beam persists for 6/7.5/9s.
If there are no Enemy Targets within 2000 units, the blast remains stationary.

build_adaptations.when: Little interrupt pressure and a safe allied entry
build_adaptations.reason: Advance the existing damage item and delay the bracelet; this reorders the same six, rather than adding a seventh item.

build_adaptations.when: Reliable attack access and a need for more basic-ability cycling
build_adaptations.reason: Trade chain-clear pressure for the item’s attack-triggered cooldown support. Respect the listed trigger limits; neither this choice nor a community guide proves an infinite reset loop.

item_effects.name: Chrono Strikes
item_effects.text:
• Decrease current Non-Ultimate Cooldowns by 8% On-Hit.
• Reduced to 4% against Non-Heroes.
• Only triggers once per ability.
• Critical Strikes grant 1.5x the cooldown reduction.

build_adaptations.when: A reachable healing threat needs an answer before crit scaling
build_adaptations.reason: Buy compatible on-attack anti-heal earlier, then revisit the flexible finish. Do not make the swap when another ally already maintains the required debuff.

item_effects.name: Blighted Strikes
item_effects.text:
• Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s.
• Deal (+10% physical power) (+20% [BonusDamage]) magical damage On-Hit.
• Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.

build_adaptations.when: The fight rewards repeated Rad Rounds windows more than an execute
build_adaptations.reason: Rad Rounds now starts its cooldown on activation, making basic-attack cooldown support relevant. This is an uptime alternative with a burst tradeoff, not a promise of permanent irradiation.

item_effects.name: Chrono Strikes
item_effects.text:
• Decrease current Non-Ultimate Cooldowns by 8% On-Hit.
• Reduced to 4% against Non-Heroes.
• Only triggers once per ability.
• Critical Strikes grant 1.5x the cooldown reduction.

build_adaptations.when: The protected partner is a burst-oriented Revenant or ability Legion
build_adaptations.reason: Advance the existing healing/shielding-triggered item for Muriel’s own power and shared haste. Its power buff is magical: do not call it a physical-power amplifier for Revenant or Legion. Later Marshal still requires an ally who can use its attack speed and its local range.

item_effects.name: Elation
item_effects.text:
• You both gain 30 Magical Power for 5s.
• You both gain 15 Ability Haste for 5s.

build_adaptations.when: An enemy spell must be answered before a full damage commitment
build_adaptations.reason: Advance the existing spell shield only when it can absorb the relevant opener. Bait spells can remove it, and earlier defense delays the damage spike.

item_effects.name: Vengeful Shroud
item_effects.text: • Gain a Spell Shield that blocks the next Ability.

build_adaptations.when: Enemy shielding repeatedly prevents the physical ability conversion
build_adaptations.reason: Consider the current anti-shield item for the named shielding problem. It gives up Dread's magical armor and Vital Shield, so keep Dread when magical burst is the bigger threat; this is a flexible-slot answer, not an automatic response to any shield icon.

item_effects.name: Demonic
item_effects.text:
• Gain 20% Movement Speed for 2s.
• Deal 45% bonus magical damage.
• Does not exceed the size of the Shield.

build_adaptations.when: Hero health and extended fights matter more than a later jungle-only clear benefit
build_adaptations.reason: A late swap for extra health and health-based magical damage in extended hero fights. Do not sell the opener automatically; repeated spells refresh the burn rather than adding independent stacks.

item_effects.name: Disintegrate
item_effects.text:
• Deal 2.5% of Target's Max Health as magical damage over 3s.
• Additional applications refresh the duration.

item_effects.name: Star Killer
item_effects.condition: On dealing Ability Damage to Heroes:
item_effects.text: • Deal 6% of Target's Bonus Health as magical damage over 3s.

build_adaptations.when: You can keep landing spells and nearby allies benefit from magical-armor reduction
build_adaptations.reason: Choose repeated-contact shred, haste and omnivamp over World Breaker's larger health-to-power payoff and tenacity. Neither effect amplifies planted-blade true damage.

item_effects.name: Shredding Spells
item_effects.condition: Upon damaging Heroes with an Ability:
item_effects.text:
• Reduce their Magical Armor by 6% for 3.5s.
• Stacks up to 5 times.

build_adaptations.when: You can keep fighting but need a larger health margin
build_adaptations.reason: Trade the late power multiplier for health and ramping magical damage. This does not turn Shinbi into a primary initiator.

item_effects.name: Fiend
item_effects.condition: On dealing Magical Damage to a Hero:
item_effects.text:
• Increases your Magical Damage dealt by 2% for 4.5s.
• Stacks up to 6 times.

build_adaptations.when: You can maintain close basic attacks and value health-based on-hit pressure
build_adaptations.reason: Rapture supplies health, attack speed and close-range, health-based on-hit damage; Double Pain explicitly applies on-hit twice. Trade away Mutilator's power, haste, higher omnivamp and ability-trigger pattern. Kiting still defeats the plan.

item_effects.name: Nearsight
item_effects.condition: While within 475u of an Enemy Unit:
item_effects.text:
• Your Basic Attacks deal 20 (+2.5% health)(+15% physical power) physical damage 
On-Hit to them.

build_adaptations.when: You can stay in close basic-attack range and need health and attack speed more than Mutilator's power and haste
build_adaptations.reason: Rapture adds health, attack speed and a close-range on-hit that scales with your health, and Double Pain applies on-hit effects twice. You give up Mutilator's power, haste, larger omnivamp and ability-triggered hits. Early 1.17 Rapture results were weak, so keep this a matchup swap; kiting still defeats it.

item_effects.name: Nearsight
item_effects.condition: While within 475u of an Enemy Unit:
item_effects.text:
• Your Basic Attacks deal 20 (+2.5% health)(+15% physical power) physical damage 
On-Hit to them.

build_adaptations.when: Allied protection gives uninterrupted attacks and physical burst is not the limiting threat
build_adaptations.reason: Add attack speed and Prism pressure at the cost of Draconum's physical power, physical armor, some haste and its healing support. Heaven's Fury applies on-hit at reduced effectiveness; do not multiply full procs by every strike.

item_effects.name: Radiant Strikes
item_effects.text:
• Deal 20 physical damage On-Hit.
• Reduces the Cooldown of Prisma by 3s.
• Applies a stack of Prism to Heroes & Monsters for 2.5s, stacking up to 3 times.
• If the Target has 3 Prism stacks on them, trigger Prisma.

item_effects.name: Prisma
item_effects.text:
• Deals 30 (+4 per Level) Damage.
• Increases from 1x-2.5x based on Target's Missing Health.

role_expansion_review.note: Eight additional role plans reviewed individually. Original 85 plans and their dates are unchanged. Experimental roles are available for deliberate locks, not automatic filling. No role win rate or tier has been authored.

maintenance_review.note: One-time review for Patch 1.17 of tiers, hero notes, counters, build adaptations, compositions and pools, over all 96 plans from the 1.17 build review. It does not start recurring AI reviews. Grades moved only with a kit or patch reason and evidence pointing the same way; most entries were retained with corrected text.
maintenance_review.rank_note: Gold+ remains the editorial reference. The Pred.gg Gold+ 1.17 sample was about 1.5 days old at review; Bronze+ contains the same games and is not independent. Statz still labels its dataset 1.16 and was used only for comparison.

perk_wording_reviews.name: Sanguine Slash
descriptions:
Blade Siphon deals 20% more damage to Isolated Targets.
Blade Siphon also heals Countess for 50% more against isolated targets.
Blade Siphon deals 20% more damage and heals 50% more against Isolated Targets.
perk_wording_reviews.reason: Both wordings give Blade Siphon 20% more damage and 50% more healing against isolated targets. Only these exact two texts are accepted; changed amounts or conditions need a new review.

sources.patch_binding: Public hero page selected with versions=166; kit has no independent version echo.
Public hero page selected with versions=167; kit has no independent version echo.

build_patch_review.scope: 2.32 full build review of every hero/role plan against live 1.17, jungle first: economy, items and order, crest, augment, Eternal, blessings, skill priority and alternatives. Gold+ is the editorial reference; the six ranks were compared separately and not pooled. This does not review tiers, compositions or strategy.
build_patch_review.limitations: No Gold+ 1.17 outcome sample exists: current-patch outcomes are Pred.gg 1.17 Bronze+ only, and loadout comparisons use the Statz 1.16 dataset. 1.17 reductions to Weald, Satariel and Lich are weighed where those loadouts lead. Level-by-level skill orders were not re-endorsed.
build_patch_review.new_hero_gap: Baron Valmont Midlane has a reviewed plan; no other role is authored for him. Legion Midlane, Zinx Carry and Rampage Offlane were authored in the 2.34 review as starting plans on very small samples.

Aion.description: Casting an Ability grants +1 Mana Regen for 8s (Max 5 Stacks). Additionally, gain Gold equal to 6% of Ability Damage dealt to Enemy Heroes.

Alpha's Court.description: Deal +6% Damage when no Allied Hero is within 800 Units.

Apex Hunter.description: Chrono Swipe deals 80% more damage to Heroes below 25% Max Health.

Arcane Resonance.description: Basic Ability Cooldowns and Philosopher progress +0.75% faster per 1 Mana Regen (Max 50%).

Assault MK-II.description: Air Assault hovers for 0.5s longer and fires an additional missile with each attack.

Betrayer's Reqiuem.description: Kingslayer uppercuts all Enemies in an area around the initial Target. Additionally, Kingslayer's Cooldown is reduced by 15%.

Rad Rounds deals 50% of its damage to nearby Enemies upon exploding.
Rad Rounds explosion radius is 600u.

Bringer Of Mercy.description: Mercy costs 10 less Mana and reduces Kira's Current Ability Cooldowns by 1s upon dealing damage.

Cascade.description: Fathom hits grant stacks. Upon reaching 5, your next direct Brine hit deals 10 (+20% magical power) Bonus Damage. Dealing Ability damage to Enemies grants 12% Attack Speed for 4s, once per ability, stacking up to 4 times.

Close Cut.description: Make Way deals 15% increased damage to the nearest Enemy Unit.

Cold Hearted.description: Receiving Basic Attack Damage from Enemy Heroes reduces their Movement Speed by 3% for 2s (Max 4 Stacks).

Combat Thrusters.description: Gain 40%/80%/200% Movement Speed during Make It Rain.

Combo Crunch.description: Dealing damage with Cross Crunch grants 5% Total Attack Speed for 3s, stacking up to 6 times.

Court of Roses.description: Iron Rose grants nearest Ally a 5s barrier with 20% Damage Reduction and attaches Thorned Vines to nearby Enemy Heroes dealing 50% damage.

Crushing Descent.description: Ascend now Stuns for 0.25s when it deals damage.

Cursed Infestation.description: Hive deals 10% more damage and has 10% increased range.

Deadly Finesse.description: If Crippling Dagger hits a Hero or kills an Enemy Unit, reduce its Cooldown by 1.5s. Hero hits also restore 20 Mana.

Death From Above.description: Akeron can fire an additional web projectile from the wall or ground once, allowing him to leap from surface to surface or to Root from where he hangs.

Devastating Bombs.description: Void Bomb deals 20% more damage to Isolated Targets.

Disc Of Demise.description: Ricochet bounces 25% further and each hit reduces its Current Cooldown by 5%, increased to 10% for Heroes.

Dryad's Boon.description: Basic Attacks decrease Basic Ability Cooldowns by 0.15s On-Hit.

Event Horizon.description: Cosmic Rift deals an additional (+4% Target's Max Health) damage to Enemies in the center.

Exarch.description: Heals or Shields grant the Target (including self) +10% Total Attack Speed and +10% Magic Damage On-Hit for 4s.

Ferocity.description: Gain +1% Total Attack Speed per Second in Hero Combat. Stacks infinitely and resets when Out of Combat.

Fervour.description: Basic Attacks against Enemy Heroes heal you and Allies within 1000 Units for 2 (+0.5 per level)(+5% Magical Power).

Flawless.description: Ability hits on Enemy Heroes heal you and Allies within 1000 Units for 8 (+10% Magical Power) (Once per cast).

Flow State.description: Evade's Cooldown is 15% lower and its Cooldown resets on Takedown.

Focal Lens.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Tachyon Lance shreds their Physical Armor by 25% for 4s and reduces the cooldown by 10%.

Forage.description: Gain 3 additional Gold and 4 additional XP per Minion or Monster Kill.

Frequency.description: Gain 2% Total Attack Speed and 2 Ability Haste per Rust stack currently applied.

Ghost in the Machine.description: After dashing with Erase Vector, become invisible for 1s.

Grim Harvest.description: Siphon now Executes Enemies that fall below 6% Max Health.

Growing Threat.description: At 16 Minutes, gain +12% Damage and +5% Omnivamp.

Heal Matrix.description: Infuse now has 2 charges but heals 10% less.

Heavy Metal.description: Heavy Punches and Shield Bash deal Bonus Magical Damage On-Hit equal to 10% of your Total Physical Armor and Magical Armor.

Hellfire Blast.description: Helllfire Rounds' Fourth Shot deals 7% more damage and ignores 30% Bonus Physical Armor.

Hypothermia.description: Damaging Enemy Heroes with Boreal Sweep shreds 15% Physical Armor and Magical Armor and slows Attack Speed by 20% for 3s.

Icy Touch.description: Basic Attacks reduce Enemy Hero Attack Speed by 3% for 3s (Max 4 Stacks).

Idrisil.description: While above 30% Max Health, gain 15% increased Physical Armor and Magical Armor. Falling below 30% Health grants a 4s Shield equal to 150% of your Total Armors. (CD: 75-32.5s)

Immaculate.description: Gain +12% Damage Reduction while above 85% Health.

Imperial Duelist.description: Your Basic Attacks debuff Targets for 3s. Against debuffed Targets, deal 5% more damage and take 5% less damage.

Infinite Obliteration.description: Synaptic Obliterator's projectile now have infinite range, travel 50% faster, and Slow for 50% longer.

Iron Resolve.description: Wild Rush grants 30/35/40/45/65% Damage Reduction while it is Channeling.

Jungle Invasion.description: Based on Hero Level, gain 4-21 Physical Power while in the Jungle. Increases to 8-42 in the Enemy Jungle.

Justice's Reach.description: Shots Fired now pierces units and has +300 additional range.

Knell.description:
Basic Attacks and Abilities against Enemy Heroes apply a stack of Rust for 5s. Each stack shreds 2% (+0.2% per Level) Physical Armor and Magical Armor, stacking up to 4 times. You gain 75% of the Armors Shredded.
Multi-hit abilities can apply stacks more than once during the same cast.

Krix.description: Gain 5% (+1% per Level) Max Health and Bonus Size equal to 0.5% of your Max Health.

Lane Lurker.description: Ancestral Fury also grants Rage against Minions, but its Health Regen is reduced by 25%/15%/5%/0% (at level 1/6/11/16).

Lotus.description: Every 2 Minutes and for each Takedown you achieve, randomly gain +1% Damage, +4 Ability Haste, +0.75% Movement Speed, or +1.5% Max Health.

Lust For Blood.description: Heal for 4-12.5% of damage dealt to Enemies afflicted with Max Bloodlust stacks. Increases with Hero Level.

Masterful Mimicry.description: Gain 1 more Max Clone and generate a stack of Hair every 5.5s.

Mind Rot.description: Vesh also deals 2% of the Target's Current Health over the Duration.

Mystic Marksman.description: Knock, Knock! deals Magical Damage instead.

Natural Infusion.description: Damaging Heroes with Harvest Nettles grants 8 Ability Haste for 5.5s, stacking infinitely.

Netherward.description: Upon using Soulfire, gain a 40 (+35% magical power) Shield for 2s.

Nightstalker.description: Eclipse's bonus Movement Speed is increased to 70%/120%/200%.

Nihil.description: Damage a Hero to gain Doom for 3s. Doom grants 1 Physical Power, 2 Magical Power, 1 Physical Armor & 1 Magical Armor every 3s Doom persists. Stats gain 20% more effectiveness per Level & Takedown.

Omnipresent.description: Gain 7% Movement Speed when Out Of Combat.

Percussive Tear.description: Each hit of Crash Bang Boom! Shreds 2.5% Armors for 3s.

Philosopher.description: Every 10s, gain 5 Gold. Interval is reduced by Ability Haste.

Photon Efficiency.description: Photon Disruptor deals 10% more damage and its Cooldown is reduced by 15% when it hits a Hero.

Phylactery.description: Casting your Ultimate grants a 15% Max Mana Shield and 100% Cooldown Progression for 4s. (20s CD).

Predator.description: Camp Leader Kills grant +10% Damage and +4% Movement Speed for 20s (100% Bonus Duration for Epic Monsters).

Preservation.description: Healing or Shielding you receive is increased by 10%.

Press the Advantage.description: Upon achieving a Takedown, a Rally Point is spawned at the dead Targets location. Rally Point no longer grants Health Regeneration but increases Legions Rate of Fire by 12/18/22/26/30% and grants Allies 10/12.5/15/17.5/20% Attack Speed.

Psychic Support.description: Essence Catalyst also restores your Linked Ally's Mana by (+10% Target's Missing Mana) over the duration.

Rallying Roar.description: Gain +10 Ultimate Haste. Casting your Ultimate grants you and Allies within 1500 Units +25% Movement Speed for 4s. Ultimate-triggered effect: 20s cooldown (official 1.17).

Regenerative Tissue.description: After not taking Hero Damage for 8s, regenerate 0.2/0.4/0.7/1% Max Health per Second.

Resonant Repair.description: Whenever you are Immobilized, gain +20 Tenacity and restore 3% of your Maximum Health over 4s.

Revelation.description: Ability casts reduce Basic Ability Cooldowns by 0.3s.

Rock & Awe.description: Boulder Throw can be ripped out mid-air. It also deals 0-80% more damage, based on distance thrown (capped at 6000 units).

Sacrosanct.description: Casting Reversal of Fortune on an Allied Hero immediately creates a Consecrated Ground at the current level at the target location.

Sanguine Slash.description:
Blade Siphon deals 20% more damage to Isolated Targets.
Blade Siphon also heals Countess for 50% more against isolated targets.

Savage Strikes.description: Deal 1.5 (+0.4 per Level) Physical Damage On-Hit. Attacking an Enemy Hero increases this by 100% for 3s (Max 3 Stacks). Heals for the Damage dealt.

Scarlet Dawn.description: Ability, Empowered Cindara, and Third Strike hits on Heroes/Camp Leaders reduce First Intent's Cooldown by 8%, reduced to 5% for Minueta hits.

Shatterbloom.description: Maco Strike creates a Healing field at the explosion location that Heals 20/30/40 (+4% magical power) every 0.25s for 5s.

Slayer of the Heavens.description: Strike of the Heavens deals 20% more damage and reduces Cooldowns by 25% more.

Soul Weaver.description: Soul Storm grants 20% (+5% per Hero Hit) Damage Reduction while active, and its Cooldown is 10% lower.

Storm of Salvation.description: Windburn lasts for 2s longer and grants (+1% Missing Health) Healing On-Hit while active. Healing is 20% effective against Non-Heroes.

Sun Shards.description: Sparrow's basic attacks ricochet 1/2/3/4 times, dealing (+20% physical power) Damage and applying On-Hit effects at 35% effectiveness.

System Restore.description: Blocking an Ability with Energy Shield restores 30 (+15% health) Health and grants 25% Decaying Movement Speed over 2s.

Taproot.description: Basic Attacks restore 1 (+8% Bonus Physical Power) Health On-Hit.

Thraex.description: Basic Attacks Mark an Enemy Hero for 3s. You deal +3% (+0.4% per level) Damage to them and take 1.5% (+0.35% per level) less Damage from them.

Tithe of Death.description: Takedowns restore 15% Max Mana and permanently grant 2 Ability Haste. (Max: 30 Ability Haste).

Turret Maniac.description: Increase your Maximum Number of Turrets to 4, but they have 20% less Health.

Tyrant of Thorns.description:
Adele triggers Crown of Thorns at 400% effectiveness. 
Royal Flourish has 9/8.5/8/7.5/7 Cooldown and provides 50% Movement Speed, but no longer Mesmerizes.

Vesh.description: Ability Damage dealt to Enemy Heroes deals +7% (+0.4% per Minute) of that Damage as a 3s DoT.

Wanton Warden.description: Regenerate Health equal to 4-7% of damage taken over 5s. Increases with Hero Level.

Weald.description: Damaging an Enemy Hero below 30% Health fires 4 (+1 per 30% Bonus Attack Speed) Projectiles, each dealing 8 (+1 per Level) True Damage and applying On-Hit effects at 30% Effectiveness (10s CD per Hero).

Wind-Rider.description: Gain 20% (+1% per Level) Attack Speed for 4s after using a Dash, Leap, Teleport or upon leaving Stealth.

Auto-Lock Amp.description: Seek and Destroy's homing speed is increased by 25%.

Bottomless Vial.description: Killing a River Buff restores a Potion charge and permanently grants 5 Magical Power.

Broken Wings.description: Your Movement Speed cannot be altered by Items or Abilities.

Combat Veteran.description: Passively gain +0.1-2 Experience each second. Increases with Hero Level. Also grants +3% Movement Speed.

Feeding Frenzy.description: Gain +12% Attack Speed per Enemy Hero within 1200 Units.

Festering Wounds.description: Your DoT abilities and Immobilizing Effects reduce Enemy Heroes' Healing by 45% for 3s.

Glacial Thorns.description: Glacial Charge spawns Hoarfrost Crystals at its base that deal 40/60/80/100/120 (+20% magical power) Damage and Root for 0.5s.

Mana Siphon.description: Ability hits on Enemy Heroes steal 10 (+1% Target's Max Mana).

Masterpiece.description: Kills grant +4% Damage and +5% Movement Speed for 12s.

Psychosis.description: Deal 3% (+0.3% per Level) more Damage to the closest Enemy Hero but 10% less Damage to any other Enemy Hero.

RAM.description: Gain 5 Magical Power and 25% Base Mana Regen on takedown, stacking infinitely. At 3 stacks gain 5% Movement Speed. Upon death, lost 50% of stacks rounded up.

Rite.description: Abilities cost an additional 5 (+2.5 per Level) Health to cast but you permanently gain 15 (+1 per Level) Ability Haste.

Runic Focus.description: Gain +0.15% Magical Power per 1% Current Mana.

Satariel.description: Takedowns grant a stack of Fearless, up to 6 times. Your Max Health is reduced by 6% (+6.5% Melee/+7.5% Ranged per Fearless). Gain +5% (+4% per Fearless) Physical Power, Magical Power and Attack Speed. Fearless stacks are lost on Death.

Scorched Earth.description: Frag Order and Saturation Charge Mines create Napalm zones upon exploding and Orbital Sanction creates one every 0.5s. Napalm zones deal 5 (+6% Bonus Physical Power) Physical Damage per 0.5s and last 3s.

Seeds of Dominion.description: Imperial Lash spawns a Thornbush under the dash target, reducing its Cooldown by 10%. Enemies are Slowed 10% and take 2 True Damage per 35u moved inside the Thornbush.

Sniper's Bounty.description: Killing Blows from Knock Knock! grant +7g, increased to +40g for Heroes.

Volcaic Slam.description: Empowered Cindara leaves behind a rupture that erupts after 0.5s. The eruption deals 20 (+4 per Level) (+25% physical power) Damage to Enemies and Slows by 40% for 1.25s.

Terminal Treatment.description: Infuse's On-Hit damage increases by 0-60%, based on Target's Missing Health.

Barkskin.description: Deal 3 (+1 per Level) Physical Damage to Enemy Heroes that Basic Attack you. This Damage triggers On-Hit Effects at 50% effectiveness.

entries.subject: valmont
entries.expected:
Your sword, Lilith, will attack the last nearby Enemy Target that is damaged by your Basic Attack, or Bloodbound, for 4s. Lilith deals 15 (+15% Magical Power) Magical Damage with each strike (increasing with Bloodbound’s Level).
Lilith’s Attack Speed is equal to Valmont’s, and she attacks faster with additional Attack Speed. She returns to Valmont if she is not attacking a Target. She will teleport back to Valmont if he travels too far away from her.
Additionally, Valmont restores 3-41 (based on Hero Level) Mana whenever an Enemy Unit dies within 1500u of Lilith. Hero deaths restore an additional 35% Maximum Mana.

When Valmont deals damage to an Enemy with Crimson Sigil or Bloodbound causes Lilith to strike them, dealing 15/23/31/39/47/23/31/39/47 (Based on Bloodbound Level) (+15% magical power) magical damage.

They differ on what directs Lilith's strikes (basic attacks in the official launch text; Crimson Sigil or Bloodbound hits in the current source); the plan does not rely on Lilith's targeting or item procs.

entries.reason: Exact item-effect comparison: numeric values, triggers, cooldowns and scaling are unchanged. The public renderer removes non-gameplay match-counter placeholders and spells out tagged damage types. This finite alternative accepts neither arbitrary missing effects nor future numerical changes.

entries.subject: Terminal Treatment
entries.expected: Infuse's On-Hit damage increases by 0-60%, based on Target's Missing Health.
entries.accepted: Refibrillator's On-Hit damage increases by 0-25%, based on Target's Missing Health.
entries.reason: Official 1.17 lowers Terminal Treatment's additional damage-over-time damage from 35% to 25%. The current Pred.gg text matches that value and names Refibrillator, Zinx's basic attack, whose hits carry the stacking damage-over-time effect. The published text (Infuse, up to 60%) is a stale rendering; the Zinx Carry plan relies only on the official 25% on-hit bonus against damaged targets.

entries.subject: Barkskin
entries.expected: Deal 3 (+1 per Level) Physical Damage to Enemy Heroes that Basic Attack you. This Damage triggers On-Hit Effects at 50% effectiveness.
entries.accepted: Deal 3 (+1 per Level) Physical Damage to Enemy Heroes that Basic Attack you. This physical damage triggers On-Hit Effects at 50% effectiveness.
entries.reason: Wording only: the damage value, per-level growth, trigger and 50% on-hit effectiveness are identical; the current source names the damage type. The Zinx Carry plan relies only on the stated reflected on-hit effect.

adaptation_review.method: Every completed item selected by each item-need rule (armour, anti-heal, CC protection, armour shred or health-based damage, anti-shield, spell shield, anti basic attack, burst insurance) was read against its current effect text, and each hero's base-kit tags used by those rules were checked. The six published ranks and the Windows data classify identically. Match adaptation of an active reviewed build is allowed only while the current data reproduce exactly these classifications.
adaptation_review.limitations: Enemy primary damage types remain unknown until a 1.17 damage review, so armour needs apply only when you choose them. Hexbound Bracers' reduction of hero basic-attack damage is not counted as an anti basic-attack answer, and Spectral Schematics' current-health damage is not counted as armour shred or health-based damage; the rules offer fewer candidates there, not wrong ones. This does not review tiers, compositions or strategy.

description_reviews.reason: The official notes change channel scaling from 30% to 40% magical power and 50% to 70% bonus physical power. This source expresses per-hit scaling instead. A hit-count conversion has not been established, so those per-hit values are not treated as current.
The notes give a 15.5–91.5% range and +4.5% per level. Those endpoints do not reconcile across 18 levels. The published range is retained, but no per-level table has been invented.

The source differs from the 1.16 release description in the third-rank base damage and the flat empowered-hit damage. The explicit 1.16.1 target-health change is corrected, but the other discrepancies remain unverified.

reviewed_definitions.name: Frost Snap
reviewed_definitions.description: Deal 10% extra damage to immobilized targets.

source_alternatives.description: Deal +10% Damage to Immobilized or Slowed Targets.

uncertainties.detail: The official 1.14 description names immobilized targets. The Statz catalog also names slowed targets. Whether a slow alone qualifies remains unverified; both sources agree on the 10% bonus against immobilized targets.

reviewed_definitions.name: Harmonic Currents
reviewed_definitions.description: Casting an ability restores missing health and missing mana over 3 seconds: one tick on activation, then one tick each second. The restoration amount remains unverified.

source_alternatives.description: Casting an Ability restores 2% of your Missing Health and Missing Mana over 3s: one tick on activation, then one tick each second.
Casting an Ability restores 2% of your Missing Health and Missing Mana over 3s.

uncertainties.detail: The 1.16 release notes specify 2.5% of missing health and mana; the Statz catalog specifies 2%. The 1.16.4 notes explicitly change timing, but do not resolve the amount.

reviewed_definitions.name: Mending
reviewed_definitions.description: After taking damage from an enemy hero, restore 3/4/5/6% of missing health at levels 1/6/11/16. The regeneration duration remains unverified.

source_alternatives.description: After taking Hero Damage, restore 3/4/5/6% Missing Health over 8s.

uncertainties.detail: The 1.14 release notes specify 3 seconds; the Statz catalog specifies 8 seconds. Later published changes update the healing percentages without resolving this duration discrepancy.
